cover.prompt: pixel-art Victorian detective game, warm lamplight, readable side-scrolling rooms cover for: The Last Hour of Pendlewick Workshop. A short cooperative locked-room mystery in a forgotten Victorian clockmaker workshop. A wealthy patron has been found dead beside a stopped astronomical clock, with three suspects, a missing brass gear, and a broken window that may be less helpful than it first appears.
